description: Connect WPConvert without an API key. kind "guest": the user confirms they are human once in the browser and gets a few free previews (no account; downloads need a purchase). kind "login": the user signs in or creates an account in the browser and types the code shown, and a new API key is saved locally. Returns a link and a short code. Show both to the user and ask them to open the link; never open it yourself. Then call wpconvert_connect_status.

kind.description: "guest" for free previews, "login" to use a WPConvert account (needed to buy).

name: wpconvert_connect
